title: Serve Robotics Delivery Robot Reportedly Crashed into Chicago Bus Shelter After Failing to Detect Glass
summary: A Serve Robotics delivery robot reportedly struck a glass bus shelter in Chicago's West Town neighborhood, shattering panels and scattering glass across the sidewalk. The company said all three sensor systems failed to detect the wall and later changed how its robots operate near bus shelters while updating their perception software and hardware.
